risk_summary: The company has minimal operating activity, declining or expired royalty streams, unresolved royalty recoupment exposure, and substantial uncertainty regarding future milestone payments and acquisitions. Its strategy depends on acquiring profitable businesses to utilize approximately $103.8 million of NOLs, but no actionable candidates have been identified. Disclosure is quantitatively informative but relies heavily on repeated disclaimers and optimistic projections that are not supported by an established operating base.
